user_story: As a user, I want registration to fail if I leave any field empty so that incomplete accounts are not created.

positive.title: Registration Fails if Field is Empty
steps: Fill in all fields except one and submit.
positive.expected_result: Registration fails and a warning message is displayed for the empty field.

negative.title: Successful Registration with All Fields Completed
steps: Fill in all required fields with valid data and submit.
negative.expected_result: Registration succeeds and a new account is created.

edge.title: Registration with Whitespace in Required Fields
steps: Fill in fields with spaces only (if applicable) and submit.
edge.expected_result: Registration fails and a warning message is displayed indicating that fields cannot be empty or only contain spaces.
